test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 20 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The Swachh Swasth ______ is an initiative to achieve better health outcomes through improved sanitation, increased awareness and healthy lifestyles.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Sarvatra__.**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Swachh Swasth Sarvatra is an initiative to achieve better health outcomes through improved sanitation and increased awareness and healthy lifestyles.**
 
• It is a joint initiative of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare and the Ministry of Drinking Water and Sanitation 
 
• It has been** launched to strengthen Community Health Centres (CHCs) in 708 Open Defecation Free (ODF) blocks in India to enable them to achieve higher levels of cleanliness and hygiene.**
 
• Under it, **Rs. 10 lakh of financial assistance will be given to the CHCs **
 
 
• to meet the standards of sanitation, hygiene, and infection control.
 
 
 
• The** initiative is a part of the Swachh Bharat Mission, under the National Health Mission.**
 
• It is focused on the **twin objectives:**
 
 
• constructing toilets.
 
• enabling behavioural change of individuals.
 
 
 
• It focused on the** goal of making India Open Defecation free by 2nd October 2019.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

 
 
• ​Decide health policy in India.
 
• It is also responsible for all government programs relating to family planning in India.
 
• **Minister: Mansukh Mandaviya.**
 
 

d8
